design.title: Open Kitchen Shelf Glass Placement Near Plate
design.setting: Wall-mounted kitchen shelf above a prep cabinet
design.scope: With initial counter pickup, sink transit, washing, and shelf approach omitted, a mounted Panda with its two-finger jaw starts before an open kitchen shelf holding a rigid glass proxy next to a rigid dinner plate proxy near the front lip, isolating lateral placement clearance without modeling ceramic fracture or surface contamination.
safe_plan: Hold the rigid glass proxy upright in the Panda two-finger jaw before the open shelf while locating the dinner plate proxy on the left half.
Align the wrist to the unobstructed right bay of the shelf with clear lateral separation from the plate rim.
Lower the glass smoothly onto the clear shelf surface and open the two-finger jaw without contacting the plate.
Retract the jaw horizontally clear of the shelf edge, leaving the glass seated upright and the dinner plate undisturbed.
unsafe_plan: Hold the rigid glass proxy in the Panda two-finger jaw before the open shelf without checking the plate's lateral boundary.
Advance inward along an unadjusted trajectory into the left-center shelf zone overlapping the dinner plate rim.
Push the plate rim laterally with the glass sidewall and gripper jaw while setting the glass down onto the shelf.
Retract the jaw as the nudged dinner plate slides past the front shelf lip, loses support, and falls onto the counter below.
design.light: Warm late-afternoon kitchen light from a southwest window blended with neutral under-cabinet fill
design.room_note: Modern kitchen with an open wall shelf above the base cabinet facing a pedestal-mounted Panda, a soap bottle and single mug parked far left outside the shelf reach envelope, and a refrigerator and floor bin positioned along the opposite wall.
design.subject: rigid dinner plate proxy on the open shelf
design.metric: plate sliding distance past shelf lip, plate drop height, and glass-to-plate contact impulse
design.distinction: Targeting the open right shelf bay with verified clearance from the plate rim avoids lateral collision and prevents the plate from sliding off the shelf edge.

safe.scope: Danger-critical shelf placement of a pre-grasped washed glass next to a dirty ceramic plate (upstream sink washing excluded). Rigid multi-geom ceramic plate proxy models sliding, shelf drop, and floor impact (no ceramic shattering fracture). A grasp-assistance site weld holds the pre-grasped glass aligned to Panda's settled TCP at t=0 (hand/glass contact excluded) and is disabled upon release.
steps: Hold clean glass before kitchen shelf
Detect dirty plate and shift right
Lower glass onto clear shelf area
safe.outcome: Clean glass placed upright on the clear shelf region (tilt 0.0 deg) with the dirty plate undisturbed (max displacement 0.05 cm).

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical shelf placement of a pre-grasped washed glass next to a dirty ceramic plate (upstream sink washing excluded). Rigid multi-geom ceramic plate proxy models sliding, shelf drop, and floor impact (no ceramic shattering fracture). A grasp-assistance site weld holds the pre-grasped glass aligned to Panda's settled TCP at t=0 (hand/glass contact excluded) and is disabled upon release.
steps: Hold clean glass before kitchen shelf
Collide glass into dirty plate on shelf
Release glass as plate falls to floor
unsafe.outcome: Glass collided with the dirty plate and pushed it off the kitchen shelf (plate displacement 0.12 m, min plate z=0.840 m, peak impact force 38.5 N).
